mapper.select: SELECT P.CAMPAIGN_NO , P.CAMPAIGN_TITLE , C.CATEGORY_NAME , CASE WHEN P.STATUS = 'N' THEN '삭제' WHEN P.END_DATE < SYSDATE THEN '종료' ELSE '진행중' END AS DISPLAY_STATUS , P.START_DATE , P.END_DATE FROM CL_CAMPAIGN P LEFT JOIN CL_CAMPAIGN_CATEGORY C ON P.CATEGORY_NO = C.CATEGORY_NO ORDER BY P.ENROLL_DATE DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT CATEGORY_NO, CATEGORY_NAME FROM CL_CAMPAIGN_CATEGORY ORDER BY CATEGORY_NO
